title: [MAIN]-Bug 642602: Address AL1430 and remove exception from ruleset
summary: Resolved an AL1430 analyzer warning by removing redundant sorting logic from a report, eliminating the need for a temporary ruleset exception without requiring schema changes.
key_points: Removed redundant sorting on extension fields that was causing AL1430 warning
Sorting fields were already fixed by DataItemLink, making explicit sorting unnecessary
Eliminated temporary ruleset exception for AL1430
No table key or schema changes required
Improves code quality by removing dead code
quote: Removed the redundant sorting and its warning suppression, then removed the temporary AL1430 ruleset exception.
